content.short: DeFiLlama provides a large TVL aggregator to track popular chains and their dApps.
content.description: DeFiLlama is one of the largest TVL aggregators. It uses TVL data to highlight the biggest protocols across popular chains such as Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, and Multichain, and their dApps, while showing how these figures evolve over time as activity expands and shifts in the ecosystem. The project emphasizes data accuracy and remains fully open-sourced, providing transparent visibility into the DeFi landscape and enabling users to compare growth, usage trends, and the relative standing of projects across networks.
